answer: AI-agent networks monitoring garden telemetry or basalt quarries can deter Sybil attacks using TPM credential activation. A verifier wraps a challenge under an asymmetric cipher tied to a chip's factory-fused endorsement key, forcing isolated silicon to unwrap the secret for an attestation key. Attackers incur the capital cost of buying distinct certified chips per identity. However, this centralizes root trust in foundries and risks hardware side-channel or decapping attacks.
